message: white_noise/flicker_noise must be a top-level additive term of a contribution
description: A noise source scaled or nested inside an expression would be dropped without a word, since its power spectral density scales as the square of any factor around it, and this simulator does not track that.
actions: Write the noise source as one term of the contribution: `I(p, n) <+ white_noise(pwr);`, with any scaling inside its power argument.
